nodes.label: icons.svg (SVG sprite: bluesky, discord, documentation, github, social, x icons)
nodes.description: SVG sprite of 6 <symbol> icons meant for <use href="/icons.svg#id">: four brand/social logos filled #08060d (Bluesky butterfly, Discord, GitHub octocat, X) and two outlined purple (#aa3bff) line icons (documentation page with code brackets, social person with star). Not referenced by anything in apps/web/src or index.html; only picked up by the PWA precache glob.
nodes.rationale: Leftover from the create-vite React-TS starter template (its default welcome page links to docs and community channels); unrelated to Boxy's inventory/invoicing UI and a candidate for removal.

nodes.label: create-vite React template scaffold asset
nodes.rationale: The icon set (Bluesky/Discord/GitHub/X + documentation/social, #aa3bff Vite purple accent) matches the default Vite starter page, indicating boilerplate that was never removed after bootstrapping apps/web.

edges.note: vite-plugin-pwa workbox globPatterns '**/*.{js,css,html,svg,png,woff,woff2}' precaches public/*.svg; built dist/sw.js lists icons.svg
